basis: Metaphyseal dysplasia, intellectual disability and conductive hearing loss define the syndrome; ocular findings occur in only 5-29%.
Fatty-acid oxidation defect with defining liver and cardiac disease; neuropathy/developmental delay 30-79%; visual loss 30-79% omitted by cap.
Inherited cutaneous UV sensitivity with xerosis and pigmentary changes; no established common extracutaneous damage.
Limb defects, ectodermal dysplasia and oral clefts define EEC; lacrimal defects 80-99% and keratitis 30-79%; renal malformations 30-79% omitted by cap.
Bone fragility defines type I OI; hearing loss develops in roughly 40-50% over adulthood. Blue sclerae do not impair vision; dentinogenesis imperfecta 5-29%.
GUCY2C deficiency causes neonatal intestinal obstruction/meconium ileus; no established extraintestinal organ damage.
Carcinoma originates in cutaneous eccrine sweat glands.
Brachydactyly and hypertension are defining features, present in nearly all; stroke is a separately diagnosed downstream complication.
Warburg micro syndrome comprises severe neurodevelopmental impairment, congenital cataracts/microphthalmia and characteristic hypogonadotropic hypogonadism.
Defined by intellectual disability, with associated brain malformations and seizures; singleton reflux and fetal pyelectasis do not establish common direct organ damage.
Complex I deficiency and lactic acidosis in 2/2; encephalopathy and myopathy each in 1/1 phenotyped patient, supporting brain and muscle involvement despite small numbers.
Distal myopathy with muscle weakness, fatty replacement and characteristic muscle pathology; no evidence of other affected axes.
Skeletal overgrowth, dysplasia and progressive deformities define the syndrome; aortic root dilatation is reported without evidence of frequency reaching 30%.
Plasma-cell disorder, obligatory neuropathy and endocrinopathy define POEMS; sclerotic bone lesions occur in ~90% and are a major criterion; common skin changes omitted by cap.
Papillary carcinoma originates at multiple sites within the thyroid gland.
Immune hyperactivation causes hemophagocytosis, cytopenias and splenic involvement; inflammatory liver injury occurs in roughly 70-90%.
Fallopian tube neoplasms arise in a reproductive organ outside the 13 axes; no common additional organ damage across this umbrella.
Chiari malformation 80-99%, hydrocephalus 30-79%; airway malformations and ear canal atresia each 30-79%; visual loss only 5-29%.
Immune-mediated CNS demyelination with progression and superimposed relapses; no additional qualifying organ involvement.
Carcinoma originates in the uterine cervix, outside the axes; HPV association does not make the carcinoma itself an infectious disease.
Whipworm infection occupies and injures colonic mucosa; anemia is chiefly a complication of heavy infection and is not established in at least 30%.
Brachydactyly and ocular coloboma/anterior segment dysgenesis define the syndrome; hearing impairment and developmental delay lack reliable frequency estimates.
Isolated pituitary growth hormone deficiency; short stature is an endocrine consequence, and scoliosis in one reported patient does not establish common skeletal damage.
Histologic variant of basal cell carcinoma originating in skin.
Congenital cleft affects the lip, alveolus and palate; otitis media is a separate secondary infection, and conductive hearing impairment occurs in only 5-29%.
